readme:
Ninfer launcher – server profiles. Edit this file and restart the launcher.
  group   = dropdown section: recommended (green, tested) | usable (amber, tested)
            | bench (blue, run via ninfer_bench.exe) | untested (red)
  vision  = none | tokens4096 | tokens8192
  mtpSpec = true/false – MTP speculation (draftTokens = drafts per step; false means MTP0)
  isBench = true → run ninfer_bench.exe instead of ninfer-serve.exe
  kvCapacityAuto = true → pass --kv-capacity auto: the engine sizes the KV pool
                to the free VRAM after loading the weights (1 GiB headroom), so an
                oversized context cannot crash startup (needs ninfer-4090 ≥ v1.2)
  hostKvMib = N → pinned system-RAM KV cache (--host-kv-mib N): inactive context is
                offloaded to RAM under VRAM pressure instead of failing (0 = engine default).
                NOTE: only builds that support the flag accept it (sergiuszm/ninfer-4090);
                the UDPSendToFailed build does NOT know --host-kv-mib – keep 0 there
